scope: Final holdout only. Methods share test episodes; parent seeds are independent training attempts. Retention pass repeats the preregistered development thresholds descriptively on test and is not a new acceptance/selection decision. Whole worker CPU unavailable per parent; body CPU excludes interpreter/import before entry and final receipt/shutdown. Common final preflight/data/bookkeeping CPU is divided equally among five methods; full-charge arithmetic also reported. Program discovery and unmeasured per-worker lifecycle CPU remain unknown. Prediction payloads and checkpoint binaries not downloaded in this audit; report/file SHA references are verified.
